examples.en: I'm a volunteer with the charity, Luan Bingran. I was beaten up because I was handing out flyers for you.
examples.zh: 我是慈善会的志愿者，栾冰然。我是为了帮您发传单，所以才被打了。

examples.en: Is this Mr. Yu Huanshui? I'm Luan Bingran. We've met before—don't you remember?
examples.zh: 是余欢水先生吗？我是栾冰然，我们之前见过的，你忘了？

tags: 酒吧遇到的女孩，公益组织「临终关怀」志愿者
